answer: Because the timing is published against the pulse challenge, the lantern audit can replay the signal history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 88 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4452 identities would post 3158 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
